title: Qualify browser candidates for customer generation and reading
description: Assess the actual packaged browser resources and declared configurations using independent customer inputs and offline reading, retaining exact-candidate evidence for release.
inputs: Identified packaged candidate, complete inventory and dependency/profile compatibility declaration.
Independent customer model, isolated generation environment and declared offline reading environment.
outputs: Attributable generation, reading, dependency and content-preservation observations for the exact candidate.
Explicit unsupported configurations, missing proof and qualification failures.
behavior: Check all generator/profile/renderer/reading resources and licenses against the artifact inventory; do not substitute a source-tree run.
Exercise minimal independent customer IDs without RigorLoop-specific content, local history or hidden acquisition.
Generate and copy a complete snapshot; inspect offline reading without the checkout, generation tools or network.
Assess safe acquisition/update boundaries and exact artifact trust, and preserve customer definitions and shared snapshots.
Keep reference-site qualification distinct and return actual observations to release coordination without authorizing publication.

failure_behavior.condition: The candidate lacks a required resource or a configuration is incompatible.
failure_behavior.outcome: Fail qualification for that scope with exact candidate identity.

failure_behavior.condition: Required customer or offline evidence is unavailable.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report an unqualified scope, not a passing sample-site substitute.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
